answer: Counterparty-diversity payouts: an agent's earnings from any one partner halve with each repeat job in an epoch, and only partners older than 30 days with outside income count at all. A clone ring paying itself is a sparrow pecking at painted seed: the marble-hard ledger records every loop and pays almost nothing. The kernel of the cost is that each fake must win real, varied customers, so 500 sybils need thousands of honest buyers, not one wallet.
